name: Build Complete React Application End-to-End
description: Create a full-stack React application with routing, state management, API integration, and deployment

prompt.template:
Design the architecture for {{appName}}.

**Specification**:
- Name: {{appName}}
- Description: {{appDescription}}
- Features: {{features}}
- Backend: {{backendType}}
- Deploy: {{deployTarget}}

**Your Task**: Create comprehensive architecture documentation.

**Architecture Considerations**:

### 1. Feature Breakdown

For each feature in {{features}}, define:
- User stories
- Data models
- API endpoints
- UI components
- State management needs

### 2. Tech Stack

**Frontend**:
- React 18+ with TypeScript
- React Router for navigation
- Zustand/Context for state
- React Query for server state
- CSS Modules/Tailwind for styling

**Backend** (if {{backendType}} is 'rest-api'):
- RESTful API design
- Authentication strategy
- Data persistence

**Testing**:
- React Testing Library (unit/integration)
- Playwright (e2e)
- MSW (API mocking)

**Deployment** ({{deployTarget}}):
- Build configuration
- Environment variables
- CI/CD pipeline

### 3. Directory Structure

```
{{appName}}/
├── src/
│   ├── components/        # Reusable UI components
│   │   ├── common/        # Shared components (Button, Input, etc.)
│   │   └── features/      # Feature-specific components
│   ├── pages/             # Route pages
│   ├── hooks/             # Custom React hooks
│   │   ├── api/           # API hooks (useQuery, useMutation)
│   │   ├── state/         # State management hooks
│   │   └── utils/         # Utility hooks
│   ├── services/          # API client and services
│   │   ├── api.ts         # API client setup
│   │   └── auth.ts        # Auth service
│   ├── stores/            # Global state stores (Zustand)
│   ├── types/             # TypeScript definitions
│   ├── utils/             # Utility functions
│   ├── routes/            # Router configuration
│   ├── styles/            # Global styles
│   └── config/            # App configuration
├── tests/
│   ├── unit/              # Unit tests
│   ├── integration/       # Integration tests
│   └── e2e/               # E2E tests (Playwright)
├── public/                # Static assets
├── .github/               # GitHub Actions
│   └── workflows/
│       └── deploy.yml
└── deployment/            # Deployment configs
```

### 4. Data Flow

```
User Action → Component → Hook → API Service → Backend
                ↓           ↓
            Local State   Cache (React Query)
                ↓
            Re-render
```

### 5. Authentication Flow (if auth feature)

```
1. User submits credentials
2. API validates and returns token
3. Token stored in localStorage/cookie
4. API client adds token to headers
5. Protected routes check auth state
6. Redirect to login if unauthorized
```

**Output**: Create `{{appName}}/ARCHITECTURE.md`

```markdown

{{appDescription}}

## Features
{{features}}

[Full tree]

```

prompt.template:
Set up deployment for {{appName}} to {{deployTarget}}.

**GitHub Actions** (`.github/workflows/deploy.yml`):
```yaml
name: Deploy

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '18'
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run typecheck
      - run: npm run lint
      - run: npm test
      - run: npx playwright install --with-deps
      - run: npm run test:e2e
  
  deploy:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v3
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build
      - name: Deploy to {{deployTarget}}
        run: |
          # Deploy command based on target
```

**Vercel** (`vercel.json`):
```json
{
  "buildCommand": "npm run build",
  "outputDirectory": "dist",
  "devCommand": "npm run dev",
  "installCommand": "npm install",
  "framework": "vite",
  "rewrites": [
    { "source": "/(.*)", "destination": "/" }
  ]
}
```

**Netlify** (`netlify.toml`):
```toml
[build]
  command = "npm run build"
  publish = "dist"

[[redirects]]
  from = "/*"
  to = "/index.html"
  status = 200
```

**Docker** (`Dockerfile`):
```dockerfile
FROM node:18-alpine AS build
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci
COPY . .
RUN npm run build

FROM nginx:alpine
COPY --from=build /app/dist /usr/share/nginx/html
COPY nginx.conf /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
EXPOSE 80
CMD ["nginx", "-g", "daemon off;"]
```

**Environment Variables** (`.env.example`):
```bash
VITE_API_BASE_URL=https://api.example.com
VITE_APP_NAME={{appName}}
```

**Set up deployment for {{deployTarget}}**.

prompt.template:
Create comprehensive documentation for {{appName}}.

**README.md**:

```markdown
# {{appName}}

{{appDescription}}

## Features

{{features}}

## Demo

[Live Demo](https://your-app.vercel.app)

## Screenshots

![Homepage](./docs/screenshots/home.png)

## Tech Stack

- **Frontend**: React 18 + TypeScript
- **State Management**: Zustand + React Query
- **Styling**: CSS Modules / Tailwind
- **Testing**: React Testing Library + Playwright
- **Deployment**: {{deployTarget}}

## Getting Started

### Prerequisites

- Node.js 18+
- npm/yarn/pnpm

### Installation

```bash
git clone https://github.com/username/{{appName}}.git
cd {{appName}}
npm install
cp .env.example .env
# Configure environment variables
npm run dev
```

## Development

```bash
npm run dev         # Start dev server
npm run build       # Build for production
npm run preview     # Preview production build
npm test            # Run unit tests
npm run test:e2e    # Run E2E tests
npm run typecheck   # TypeScript check
npm run lint        # Lint code
```

## Project Structure

```
src/
├── components/     # UI components
├── pages/          # Route pages
├── hooks/          # Custom hooks
├── services/       # API services
├── stores/         # State stores
├── types/          # TypeScript types
└── utils/          # Utilities
```

## Testing

See [TESTING.md](./docs/TESTING.md)

## Deployment

See [DEPLOYMENT.md](./docs/DEPLOYMENT.md)

## Contributing

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md)

## License

MIT
```
